UI_ZeD_Workshop_SeenLink: Seen by anyone with the link.
UI_ZeD_Workshop_SendFailed: Steam would not take the upload. Is Steam running and signed in?
UI_ZeD_Workshop_Uploaded: Uploaded. It is item %1 on the Workshop.
UI_ZeD_Workshop_UploadedLegal: Uploaded. It is item %1 on the Workshop. Steam asks you to accept the Workshop agreement on its page before others can see it.
UI_ZeD_ModDesc: Total UI overhaul for Project Zomboid
UI_ZeD_Settings_SandboxIGTip: Adds a Sandbox options line to the pause window, for changing this save's sandbox settings without starting a new game. Single player only.
UI_ZeD_Options_UnderSandboxIG: A line in the pause window
UI_ZeD_SbxWhen_now: Takes effect as soon as you apply.
UI_ZeD_SbxWhen_new: Only for places you have not been to yet: rooms, containers, cars and areas are filled the first time you see them. What you already found stays as it is.
UI_ZeD_SbxWhen_chr: Only for a character made after this, for example after a death in this world. Your current character keeps what it had.
UI_ZeD_SbxWhen_fix: Used once, when this world was made. Changing it now would do nothing, so it is locked.
UI_ZeD_Sbx_ChangedNone: No changes yet. Settings you change are listed here until you apply them.
UI_ZeD_Sbx_WorldDay: This world is on day %1 of the count the shut-offs use. %2. %3.
UI_ZeD_Sbx_HistNone: Nothing applied yet. Every change you apply is listed here with the in-game date, and stays in the save.
UI_ZeD_Sbx_PutBackHelp: Sets %1 back to %2. It waits on the Changed page until you apply it.
UI_ZeD_Sbx_Applied: Applied %1. The game keeps them when it next saves.
UI_ZeD_Sbx_HelpNone: Point at a setting to read what it does, what changing it does to this save, and a tip.
UI_ZeD_Sbx_WarnCare: Careful: you can change it back.
UI_ZeD_SbxWhen_load: The game reads this only when the save loads. Apply, save, quit to the main menu and continue to see it.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_DayLength: Days get longer or shorter in real time from now on. The clock and the date do not move. Needs, healing, food spoiling and crop growth run on game time, so they follow the new day length.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_TimeSinceApo: Each month adds 30 days to the world's age. Raising it ages the world at once: water and power go off if the new age is past their shutoff days, and areas you have not seen yet are made older (more looted buildings, corpses, flat car batteries).
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_TimeSinceApo: To move only the water or power shutoff, change Water Shutoff (day) or Electricity Shutoff (day) on the World page. Lowering this gives the days back.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_Zombies: The game hands this count to its zombie population manager when the save loads, so a change shows after the next load. Rooms and stories you open use the new count at once.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_Zombies: To see the new count outdoors, save and load the game again.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_Distribution: The game reads this when the save loads. It shapes where zombies are placed in areas that are not filled yet. Zombies already placed may stay where they are.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieVoronoiNoise: The game reads this while it loads the map data, so a change shows after the next load.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieRespawn: This is a shortcut for the three Respawn numbers in Advanced Zombie Options. The game reads those when the save loads, so respawning starts or stops after the next load.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_ZombieRespawn: None keeps cleared areas clear. Above None, zombies can return to areas you have cleared, including around your base.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieMigrate: This is a shortcut for Redistribute Hours in Advanced Zombie Options. The game reads that number when the save loads, so a change starts after the next load.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieLore_Strength: Takes effect at once for bites and hits on you and for zombies hitting doors. Zombies already out there also pick it up when they next load.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieLore_Toughness: Applies to zombies made after the change, such as new spawns and risen corpses. Zombies already out there keep their toughness.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieLore_Transmission: Applies to bites, scratches and deaths from now on.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieLore_Mortality: Read as infection runs, so a character who is already infected may follow the new timing.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieLore_Reanimate: Applies to corpses of the infected from now on.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieLore_SpottedLogic: Read every time a zombie checks for you, so it applies at once.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieLore_ThumpNoChasing: Read when a zombie bumps into something, so it applies at once.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieLore_ThumpOnConstru: Read when a zombie hits something you built, so it applies at once.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieLore_ActiveOnly: Read every game update, so it applies at once.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieLore_TriggerHouseAl: Read when a window or door is broken or opened, so it applies at once.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieLore_ZombiesDragDow: Read each time a zombie attacks, so it applies at once.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieLore_ZombiesCrawler: Read each time a zombie attacks, so it applies at once.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieLore_ZombiesFenceLu: Read when a zombie climbs a fence or window, so it applies at once.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieLore_DisableFakeDea: Read when corpses and downed zombies are set up or updated. Corpses already lying around may keep the state they have.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieLore_ZombiesArmorFa: Read on every hit, so it applies at once.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieLore_ZombiesMaxDefe: Read on every hit, so it applies at once.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieLore_ChanceOfAttach: The game reads this once after the save loads, when it makes the first zombie, so a change shows after the next load. It then applies to zombies made from that point.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieLore_ZombiesFallDam: Read when a zombie lands from a height, so it applies at once.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieLore_PlayerSpawnZom: Applies when a new character spawns in this world, for example after a death. It clears zombies near where that character appears. Your current character has already spawned.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieConfig_PopulationMu: This is the number behind Zombie Count. The game sends it to its zombie population manager when the save loads, so a change starts after the next load.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_ZombieConfig_PopulationMul: To see the new count outdoors, save and load the game again.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieConfig_PopulationSt: The game sends this to its zombie population manager when the save loads, so a change starts after the next load.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieConfig_PopulationPe: The game sends this to its zombie population manager when the save loads, so a change starts after the next load.
The game sends this to its zombie population manager when the save loads, so a change starts after the next load.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieConfig_RespawnHours: The game sends this to its zombie population manager when the save loads, so a change starts after the next load. Above 0, zombies can return to areas you have cleared.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieConfig_RespawnUnsee: The game sends this to its zombie population manager when the save loads, so a change starts after the next load.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieConfig_RespawnMulti: The game sends this to its zombie population manager when the save loads, so a change starts after the next load.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieConfig_Redistribute: The game sends this to its zombie population manager when the save loads, so a change starts after the next load. 0 turns migration off.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieConfig_FollowSoundD: The game sends this to its zombie population manager when the save loads, so a change starts after the next load.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieConfig_RallyGroupSi: Read when a zombie group forms, so it applies to groups formed from now on.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZombieConfig_ZombiesCount: Only a multiplayer server uses this number. A single-player game ignores it.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_HoursForLootRespawn: Turning it on lets containers in towns and trailer parks refill with loot, including ones you have emptied. The game checks areas as they load and as time passes. A container holding fewer than Max Items For Loot Respawn items refills, and the new loot is added to what is there.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_HoursForLootRespawn: Construction Prevents Loot Respawn keeps buildings you have built in or barricaded from refilling. 0 turns respawn off.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_SeenHoursPreventLootRespaw: Only has an effect while Hours for Loot Respawn is above 0.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_MaxItemsForLootRespawn: Only has an effect while Hours for Loot Respawn is above 0.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ConstructionPreventsLootR: With it off and Hours for Loot Respawn above 0, buildings you have built in or barricaded can refill with loot too, and so can your own storage there.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_MaximumLooted: Read when the game decides whether a building was looted before you came. Buildings you have already seen keep their state.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_DaysUntilMaximumLooted: Read when the game decides whether a building was looted before you came. Buildings you have already seen keep their state.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_DaysUntilMaximumLooted: The chance rises with the world's age, which includes Months since the Apocalypse.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_RuralLooted: Read when the game decides whether a building was looted before you came. Buildings you have already seen keep their state.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_MaximumDiminishedLoot: Read each time a container is filled, so it applies to containers filled from now on.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_DaysUntilMaximumDiminishe: Read each time a container is filled, so it applies to containers filled from now on.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_DaysUntilMaximumDiminished: The effect grows with the world's age, which includes Months since the Apocalypse.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_MaximumLootedBuildingRoom: Read when a building is first set up. Buildings you have already seen keep their state.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_LootItemRemovalList: Write item types as Module.Name, for example Base.Hat, with commas between.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_RollsMultiplier: The game text advises leaving this at 1.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_WaterShutModifier: Checked all the time against the world's age in days. Set a day in the past and the taps stop now. Set a day in the future and they run again. Water already in pots, bottles and barrels is not touched.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_WaterShutModifier: -1 means off from the start. 2147483647 keeps the water on for good. The world's day count is at the top of this page.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ElecShutModifier: Checked all the time against the world's age in days. Set a day in the past and the grid goes off now: lights stop, and fridges and freezers warm so food spoils. Set a day in the future and it comes back. Generators keep working.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_ElecShutModifier: -1 means off from the start. 2147483647 keeps the power on for good. The world's day count is at the top of this page.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_WaterShut: The shutoff day was picked from this range when the world was made. Changing the range does not pick a day again, so it is locked.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_WaterShut: To move the day, change Water Shutoff (day).
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ElecShut: The shutoff day was picked from this range when the world was made. Changing the range does not pick a day again, so it is locked.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_ElecShut: To move the day, change Electricity Shutoff (day).
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_AlarmDecay: Each building gets its alarm battery time from this setting when the map data is first made. Buildings already stored in the save should keep theirs.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_Alarm: Each building gets its alarm, or none, from this setting when the map data is first made. Buildings already stored in the save should keep their alarm state.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_LockedHouses: Read when a door or window is first made. Doors and windows you have seen keep their state.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_GeneratorTileRange: A generator takes its range when it is placed or when the save loads. Generators already running keep their range until you reload.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_GeneratorVerticalPowerRan: A generator takes its range when it is placed or when the save loads. Generators already running keep their range until you reload.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_FuelStationGasMin: A pump gets its starting fuel the first time the game checks it. Pumps already checked should keep their amount.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_FuelStationGasMax: A pump gets its starting fuel the first time the game checks it. Pumps already checked should keep their amount.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_FuelStationGasEmptyChance: A pump gets its starting fuel the first time the game checks it. Pumps already checked should keep their amount.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_FoodRotSpeed: Changes how fast all food spoils from now on, including food in your fridge and bags.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_FoodRotSpeed: Slower spoiling does not make rotten food fresh again.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_DaysForRottenFoodRemoval: Food that has been rotten for more than this many days is deleted the next time the game updates it. This can include food in containers. Compost bins are skipped. Deleted food does not come back.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_DaysForRottenFoodRemoval: -1 never removes it. Leave it at -1 if you keep rotten food in containers for compost.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_WorldItemRemovalList: Items of these types lying loose in the world, on the ground or on a surface, are deleted once they have been there longer than Hours for Removal List, when that part of the map loads. Items you dropped yourself count. Deleted items do not come back.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_WorldItemRemovalList: Items inside containers and bags are not touched. Pick up anything you want to keep before adding its type here.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_HoursForWorldItemRemoval: Lowering it deletes listed items sooner, including ones already lying there. The check runs when that part of the map loads. 0 stops the removal.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ItemRemovalListBlacklistT: Turns the list around: every loose item that is NOT on World Item Removal List is deleted after Hours for Removal List, when its part of the map loads. On a lived-in save that can clear the floors and surfaces of your base.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_ItemRemovalListBlacklistTo: Leave it off unless you mean to clear the world.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_Basement_SpawnFrequency: No code in the game reads this setting in this build, so changing it does nothing.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_MaximumFireFuelHours: Read when you add fuel. Fuel already in a fire or stove is not changed.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_Temperature: The game code reads this only when the save loads, to set the plant growth seasons. No other use was found, so it may not change the weather temperature.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_Rain: Applies to weather the game plans from now on. A front already under way may run its course.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ErosionSpeed: The growth speed is stored in the save's erosion file when the world is made. Changing it afterwards does nothing, so it is locked.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_ErosionSpeed: Erosion Days still works, but it can reset growth. Read its note first.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ErosionDays: Read every ten game minutes. Above 0, growth is worked out from a counter that does not start where your world's growth is, so growth can drop back or jump ahead. -1 stops growth and clears it. Setting 0 again does not bring it back.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_ErosionDays: Leave this at 0 on a world that already has growth you want to keep.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_FarmingSpeedNew: Read each time a plant is scheduled for its next growth stage. A stage already scheduled keeps its time.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_FarmingAmountNew: Read when you harvest. In this build the farming code works out the result but does not appear to use it, so it may have no effect.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_KillInsideCrops: Turning it on drains health from crops growing indoors, until they die. Greenhouse rooms and house plants are exempt.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_PlantGrowingSeasons: Turning it on makes crops outdoors suffer in bad months and in winter. Crops already planted out of season lose health quickly and can die.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_PlantGrowingSeasons: The season rules only apply to crops outdoors.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_MaximumRatIndex: Read when the game fills an area for the first time. Areas you have already seen keep their state.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_DaysUntilMaximumRatIndex: Read when the game fills an area for the first time. Areas you have already seen keep their state.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_DaysUntilMaximumRatIndex: The index rises with the world's age, which includes Months since the Apocalypse.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ClayLakeChance: Read when ground is generated for the first time. Ground you have already seen keeps its tiles.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ClayRiverChance: Read when ground is generated for the first time. Ground you have already seen keeps its tiles.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_Helicopter: Read when the game plans each flyover. A flyover already planned still happens if you set Never. Moving from Never or Once to Sometimes or Often plans a new one.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_SurvivorHouseChance: Read when a building is first set up. Buildings you have already seen keep what they have.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_VehicleStoryChance: Read when a road story is first set up. Stories already placed stay.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ZoneStoryChance: Read when a zone story is first set up. Stories already placed stay.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_AnnotatedMapChance: Read when a map is made. Maps you already hold keep their notes, or lack of them.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_HoursForCorpseRemoval: Zombie corpses older than this many hours are removed, and so is what they carry. Lowering it can clear corpses you have left lying around. 0 or less turns removal off.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_BloodSplatLifespanDays: Old blood splats are removed as map chunks load, so setting it can clear them for good. 0 keeps them forever.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_Map_MapAllKnown: Read the first time the game uses the map after the save loads. If it is on then, the whole world map is marked as known and saved that way. Turning it off later does not forget the map.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_StarterKit: Only a character made after this gets the kit.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ConstructionBonusPoints: Read when something finishes building. Applies to what you build from now on. Things already built keep their strength.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_NoBlackClothes: Read when a random clothing colour is picked, for example for a zombie that spawns. Clothes already made keep their colour.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_FirearmNoiseMultiplier: In this game only weapon reloading reads this number. No other use was found.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_MinutesPerPage: Read when you start reading a book. A book you are already reading keeps its pace.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_MultiplierConfig_Global: Only counts while Use Global Multiplier is on.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_MultiplierConfig_GlobalTog: On: every skill uses Global Multiplier. Off: each skill uses its own row.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_EnableVehicles: Only affects areas the game fills for the first time. Cars already in the world stay where they are.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_VehicleEasyUse: Read when you start a car and when cars are made. Off: a car needs its key or a hotwire. Cars made while it was on carry their key in the glove box.
UI_ZeD_SbxTip_VehicleEasyUse: Turning it off can leave you in a car whose key you do not hold.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_RecentlySurvivorVehicles: Read when a car is first made. Cars already in the world keep their state.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_CarSpawnRate: Only affects areas the game fills for the first time. Cars already in the world stay where they are.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_ChanceHasGas: Read when a car is first made. Cars already in the world keep their fuel.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_InitialGas: Read when a car is first made. Cars already in the world keep their fuel.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_LockedCar: Read when a car is first made. Cars already in the world keep their locks.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_CarGeneralCondition: Read when a car is first made. Cars already in the world keep their condition.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_TrafficJam: Only affects areas the game fills for the first time. Wrecks already on the road stay where they are.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_CarAlarm: Read when a car is first made. Cars already in the world keep their alarm state.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_AnimalEggHatch: Read when an egg is made. Eggs already laid keep their hatch time.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_AnimalRanchChance: Read when a farm is first set up. Farms you have already seen keep their animals.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_AnimalTrackChance: Read when the game places animal tracks. Tracks already placed stay.
UI_ZeD_SbxSave_AnimalPathChance: Read when an area is first set up. Areas you have already seen keep their paths.
UI_ZeD_SbxSecSave_ZombieLore: Most of these are set on each zombie as it is made or loads in. Zombies already out there may keep their old ways until you leave the area and come back.
UI_ZeD_SbxSecSave_LootRarity: Applies to containers filled from now on. Containers already filled keep their loot.
UI_ZeD_SbxSecTip_LootRarity: Raising it makes new places richer. Places you have already looted stay looted unless loot respawn is on (Hours for Loot Respawn, top of the Loot page).
UI_ZeD_SbxSecSave_XPMultipliers: XP earned from now on uses the new rate. Levels already earned stay.
UI_ZeD_SbxSecTip_XPMultipliers: The skill rows only count while Use Global Multiplier is off.
UI_ZeD_SPNCC_NewText: Spongie's Character Customisation is new to this save. Pick a face and details, then Save. The game waits, paused, until you save or close this window.
UI_ZeD_SPNCC_NoDetails: None of the mods on adds details.
UI_ZeD_SPNCC_SpiffoText: While you carry it, the face and details can change.
